opportunities.title: Historic buildings and structures (Preservation and Conservation grants)

amount.raw: Generally, £1,000 to £30,000 (average approx. £15,000). Sometimes larger sums are considered.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charity, organisation with exempt charitable status, recognised public body, Community Benefit Society, or Community Interest Company (CIC) limited by guarantee. Project must be UK based, focus on a listed building or structure, and not be complete (no retrospective grants).
opportunities.summary: Grants to fund the preservation and repair of listed historic buildings, structures and architectural features, with special consideration for buildings at risk and of outstanding importance, and for sustainable conservation and re-use. Covers project costs, staff costs, fees, internships, initial exploratory work and capital costs. Stage one applications considered on a rolling basis; stage two applications above £5,000 considered quarterly at Board meetings.

opportunities.title: Places of worship (Preservation and Conservation grants)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Funds conservation of historic interiors and historic objects in places of worship open for regular worship. Anglican churches must apply via the ChurchCare conservation grants scheme (part-funded by the Trust); all other denominations, faiths and cathedrals may apply directly. Grants for redundant/closed places of worship are handled under Historic Buildings and Structures.
opportunities.summary: Grants for the conservation of historic interiors and historic objects in places of worship open for regular worship, including bells, books and manuscripts, clocks, decorative plasterwork, metalwork and church plate, monuments, organs, paintings, stained glass, textiles, timberwork, wall paintings and historic structures in churchyards, plus conservation reports and technical investigations. Stage one applications considered on a rolling basis; stage two applications above £5,000 considered quarterly at Board meetings.

opportunities.title: Conservation of cultural heritage (Preservation and Conservation grants)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charity, organisation with exempt charitable status, recognised public body, Community Benefit Society, or Community Interest Company (CIC) limited by guarantee. Applicants must not be eligible for the grant programmes run by AIM and NMCT. Project must be UK based and not complete (no retrospective grants).
opportunities.summary: Grants to support the conservation of culturally and historically significant collections and objects, including works of art, books, significant ephemera, artefacts and archives. Covers project costs including staff costs, fees, paid internships, initial exploratory work and conservation costs. Conservation should be carried out by an accredited conservator, enable greater public access, and encourage internships and knowledge sharing. Stage one applications considered on a rolling basis; stage two applications above £5,000 considered quarterly at Board meetings.
